Returns the character code of the first character of a string. It is the opposite of [Chr](Chr).

```blitzbasic
;run
Print Asc("A")
Print Asc("BCD")
```

```text
65
66
```
@param string  The text. Only its first character counts.
@returns A code from 0 to 255, or -1 if the string is empty.
